title: The Salt Landfall
author: Theo Nakamura
blurb: Sable Oyelaran, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
